aurora.bg: radial-gradient(circle at 12% 8%, rgb(56 189 248 / 0.16), transparent 28rem), radial-gradient(circle at 88% 18%, rgb(168 85 247 / 0.14), transparent 30rem), radial-gradient(circle at 50% 95%, rgb(34 197 94 / 0.10), transparent 28rem), var(--page-background)

gradient.bg: linear-gradient(135deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--page-background) 72%, white) 0%, var(--page-background) 50%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--page-background) 80%, black) 100%)

grid.bg: linear-gradient(var(--details-border) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, var(--details-border) 1px, transparent 1px), var(--page-background)

glow.bg: radial-gradient(circle at top, var(--page-glow), transparent 28rem), var(--page-background)
